model_rules: Do not remove acquisition spending while retaining acquisition-driven growth.
Existing 3Cloud/Astreya revenue does not require buying those companies again.
Model new deal recognition timing; full annual growth cannot accompany every midyear deal immediately.

DyFlex is agreed for approximately USD210m cash payable at closing, expected Q1 2027, subject to closing adjustments and conditions. Include this announced-deal exception in the owned-business cross-check or explicitly label its exclusion as counterfactual. Include its cash cost within, not in addition to, a 2027 funded acquisition budget already covering the deal; revenue/EBIT remain unknown. Count cost in future acquisition cash flow or bridge once, never both.
Do not add SBC back if shares held constant.
Internal-use and saleable software are already included in PPE capex; cloud implementation and contract costs may instead be in operating assets.
Count contract capitalization in NWC or separately, never both.
If no future acquisitions, run off old acquisition amortization and use a defensible terminal reinvestment/ROIC framework.
Do not add Leap savings on top of margins that already include them or deduct Leap cash twice in a guidance-derived stub.
Hold current FX level explicitly; do not extrapolate another 90bps margin benefit each year.
Treat operating leases consistently in EBIT and bridge.
Exclude escrow and tax deposits from excess cash; do not deduct the same deposited disputed tax principal twice.
Astreya earnout and pension deficit belong in bridge or explicit future cash costs, not both.
Normalize taxes without equating Q1's discrete tax benefit or 2025's tax asset writeoff with perpetual tax expense.
Capital returns after September cannot reduce shares without spending cash.
